description: 해양수산부 국립해양조사원_연안 침수 정보 조회 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부 국립해양조사원. 이 데이터는 해양수산부 국립해양조사원에서 2009년~2020년까지 제작된 100년빈도 규모의 연안 인접지역 침수범위 예측정보를 제공하기 위해 수집한 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부 국립해양조사원. Its tags are 태풍, 침수, 폭풍해일, 수치예측모델, 공간정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
